tool.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
tool.description: IBM agent platform whose Agentic Control Plane adds operations dashboards, policy and access governance, and a shared agent catalog.
strengths: Shared catalog to publish and version agents
Policy, credential health and access overview
SaaS on AWS or IBM Cloud, or on-premises
tool.pricing: 30-day free trial; Essentials from $530/month, Standard from $6,360/month; Premium by quote.
tool.statusNote: Agentic Control Plane announced 2026-07-02, available on AWS and IBM Cloud.
tool.practitionerNote: Worth evaluating when agents must run on-premises or in regulated IBM/AWS GovCloud estates; the control plane is part of Orchestrate, so it governs best what is built or registered there.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Choice of IBM Cloud, AWS, AWS GovCloud (US) or on-premises installs lets customers place data; per-region detail not reviewed.

deployment.detail: SaaS on AWS, IBM Cloud and AWS GovCloud (US), plus watsonx Orchestrate On-premises.

auditLogging.detail: Operational dashboards, agent analytics and observability traces; a dedicated audit log is not described in the announcement.

soc2.detail: No watsonx Orchestrate-specific SOC 2 scope found on IBM pages reviewed.

iso27001.detail: watsonx Orchestrate is not named on the IBM Cloud ISO 27001 page reviewed; scope unverified.

iso42001.detail: No ISO 42001 statement for watsonx Orchestrate found in reviewed sources.

euAiAct.detail: Agent build and governance platform, not itself a high-risk AI system; obligations rest with deployers of specific agents.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary IBM product with published tiered subscription pricing.
